**FOUR Lua dispatch surfaces** with TWO distinct dispatch cores (final taxonomy): (1) PRIMARY sync via FUN_00CC7A90 -> FUN_00CCF7D0 (79 inventoried sites); (2) ALT sync via FUN_00CD25C0 -> FUN_00CCF7D0 (1 site `_onCommand`); (3) US-SCHEDULED via FUN_00CF63E0 -> FUN_00CF6080 -> FUN_00CF5EC0 -> FUN_00CCF7D0 (queue-driven, QueryPerformanceCounter-based); (4) **MS-SCHEDULED via FUN_00CDA330 -> FUN_00CEF510 -> FUN_00CE1840 -> FUN_00CCEAC0** (BCS-Y-1697 NEW, queue-driven, timeGetTime-based, **SEPARATE DISPATCH CORE distinct from FUN_00CCF7D0**).

**FUN_00CCEAC0 is the MS-SCHEDULED DISPATCH CORE** (BCS-Y-1697 NEW, 493 bytes, sole caller FUN_00CE1840). Has 4 routing branches based on callback-type checks (FUN_00CF3D80/D60/D90) leading to 3 dispatch invokers (FUN_00CD3E70/D3990/D4080). Uses time conversion (*param_4 & 0x7fff) / DAT_00F91C48 for the time parameter. ARCHITECTURALLY DISTINCT from FUN_00CCF7D0.

**FUN_00CCF7D0 has EXACTLY 3 callers** (corrected from the earlier '20 callers' claim). FindAllReferencesToAddress on 0x00CCF7D0 returned only 3 UNCONDITIONAL_CALL references: FUN_00CC7A90 (primary sync), FUN_00CD25C0 (alt sync), FUN_00CF5EC0 (us-scheduled). The '20 callers' claim in the BCS-Y-0399 amendment was incorrect - it likely counted internal helpers from a different metric (Ghidra function-graph view or callee transitive closure, not actual callers).

**Complete Lua tick architecture mapped**: FUN_004DA680 (game loop) -> [[LuaFrameTick_FUN_00578970]] (BCS-Y-1701 NEW, 306 bytes) -> [[LuaTickOrchestrator_FUN_00CC98A0]] (BCS-Y-1694 NEW, 42 bytes) -> [[LuaSchedulerMaintenance_FUN_00CDA330]] (BCS-Y-1695 NEW, 715 bytes) -> [[LuaSchedulerTickMs_FUN_00CEF510]] (BCS-Y-1696 NEW, 773 bytes) + [[LuaSchedulerTickUs_FUN_00CF63E0]] (BCS-Y-1699 NEW). **Scheduled callbacks are NOT literal-name fire sites**: they use COMPUTED event IDs from per-object state (e.g., `*param_1 + 0x128` in FUN_00CF5EC0's invocation of FUN_00CCF7D0), NOT literal string event names via FUN_00447260. Therefore the inventory of LITERAL-NAME fires is COMPLETE at 80 sites (79 inventoried + 1 `_onCommand`). The scheduled-dispatch surface is a SEPARATE mechanism with different identity semantics, not enumerable as additional fire sites in that sense.
